description: This Java test file contains unit tests for the CloseConnection class, which is part of the connectivity commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies behaviors such as JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, equality, and resource path retrieval.

classes.name: CloseConnectionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the CloseConnection command implementation in Eclipse Ditto, verifying JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and resource path retrieval.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that CloseConnection correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Ensures that instances of CloseConnection are immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Tests that creating a CloseConnection instance with a null ConnectionId throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the CloseConnection.fromJson method correctly reconstructs an object from JSON.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getResourcePath returns the correct JSON pointer for the command.
